function buildSettingsSnapshot(s, cam): object

Defined in: experiments/earth-playground/earth/settings.ts:56

Snapshot of every tunable, shaped exactly like DEFAULT_SP_GUI so the playground control panel can render sliders without knowing which values are live uniforms vs build-time constants. ?? fallbacks cover the pre-bootstrap window where the private state is still null.
